title: PdfSurvey
description: Cheap deterministic survey completed before any page rasterization or OCR.

container_metadata.description: Selected deterministic PDF Info/Catalog metadata. Missing keys remain absent.

family_features.description: Coarse deterministic family features suitable for grouping, not a family decision.

repeated_margin_text_hints.description: Exact repeated edge-line candidates for later header/footer classification.

script_hints.description: Document-level script families observed in native text.

PageContentHint.description: Cheap, deterministic classification of a PDF page before OCR.

oneOf.description: No native text, image invocation, or painted vector path was observed.
Native text was observed without image invocations.
Image invocations were observed without native text.
Native text and image invocations were both observed.
Content operators were observed but native text and image evidence were inconclusive.

PdfPageSurvey.description: Per-page evidence gathered without rasterization or OCR.

candidate_kinds.description: Conservative page-level candidate kinds for later region refinement.

height_points.description: Effective crop-box height in PDF points.

high_value_candidate.description: Whether refinement is likely valuable because native text is absent or mixed with imagery.

native_characters.description: Number of non-whitespace native Unicode scalar values.

native_characters_per_square_point.description: Native character count divided by page area in square points.

native_text_sha256.description: Exact normalized native-text fingerprint, absent when no text was recovered.

native_text_simhash.description: Deterministic 64-bit token SimHash for near-duplicate candidate generation.

painted_vector_paths_per_square_point.description: Painted vector-path count divided by page area in square points.

script_hints.description: Unicode script families observed in native text.

text_show_operations.description: Number of PDF text-show operators, including text that could not be decoded.

width_points.description: Effective crop-box width in PDF points.

xobject_invocations.description: Number of PDF image/form invocation operators. Forms are not misreported as images.

xobject_invocations_per_square_point.description: XObject invocation count divided by page area in square points.

RepeatedMarginTextHint.description: Exact repeated first/last native-line hint across pages; this is not a header/footer decision.

page_indexes.description: Pages on which the exact line occurs in that position.

text_sha256.description: Exact normalized line fingerprint; source text is not duplicated in the survey.
